title: Procurement Priority Playbook — 1:1 Prep
content:
Purpose:
Prep notes for 1:1 with Sam (Finance lead) — align on near-term procurement approvals, run-rate impact, and a proposed prioritization for March procurement wave. This is a scratchpad: rough numbers, scripts to use in the meeting, and direct follow-ups.

Context summary (for quick hit in 1:1):
- Current committed monthly run-rate estimate: ~$1.14M (Feb snapshot).
- March procurement requests under review: total ask ~ $430k one-time + $95k recurring/mo.
- Two priority categories: (1) capacity/cost-reduction (inference infra), (2) product feature enabling (console/observability), (3) one-off compliance work.
- Goal: keep net new recurring run-rate increase <= $60k/mo for Q2 unless board-approved, and accelerate items with >1.5x ROI within 6 months.

Agenda (15–20m):
1) Quick alignment on run-rate guardrail and exceptions (3m)
2) Walk through prioritized procurement list and ask sizes (7–8m)
3) Decide approvals to move to exec review vs. defer (5m)
4) Confirm owners and deadlines for follow-ups (2m)

Key procurement items (short bullets to expand in meeting):
- Vendor: OptiBatch (inference batching engine) — one-time integration + license: $210k, expected infra cost savings ~ $45k/mo post-rollout; payback ~5–6 months. Impact: reduces token cost; ties to Dedicated capacity KPIs. Owner: Priya.
- Vendor: TraceLens observability — recurring: $28k/mo, one-time setup $40k. Benefit: consolidated traces and token-level cost attribution; reduces ops time ~0.5 FTE-equivalent. Owner: Marco.
- Compliance consultancy: RedSeal Advisory — one-time $95k, required for certain Private deployment timelines and audit artifacts. Benefit: unblock customer deals worth $1.2M ARR. Owner: Mia.
- Misc: EC2 spot commitment bump (capacity commit) — recurring +$15k/mo to guarantee burst capacity during spikes. Ops argues this avoids throttling for premium tier. Owner: SRE lead.

Suggested prioritization (A/B/C):
- A (Approve ASAP): OptiBatch (high ROI, infra cost reduction), Compliance consultancy (unblocks enterprise revenue).
- B (Discuss): TraceLens (higher recurring), EC2 bump (small recurring but operational risk mitigated).
- C (Defer/Monitor): Low-dollar tooling/subscriptions under $5k/mo.

Discussion prompts / scripts:
- "If we greenlight OptiBatch now, timeline to measurable savings? What are integration risks?"
- "For TraceLens: can we negotiate pilot pricing or a 90-day trial tied to adoption metrics?"
- "Compliance spend: can we stage deliverables to match customer contract milestones and stretch payments?"

Run-rate math (back-of-envelope for meeting):
- Baseline monthly committed run-rate: $1,140,000
- If we approve OptiBatch (savings) and TraceLens (+$28k): net recurring delta = +$15k/mo (optibatch assumed cost-neutral after savings)
- If we approve compliance + EC2 bump: +$110k one-time + $43k/mo recurring 
- Quick rule: keep recurring additions <= $60k/mo unless offset by >=$40k/mo immediate savings or board sign-off.

Risk checklist (to call out quickly):
- Integration delay risk (OptiBatch) — contingency: phased rollout + rollback plan.
- Hidden costs in TraceLens (extra retention) — ask for pricing tiers.
- Compliance deliverables scope creep — require statement-of-work with milestones and acceptance criteria.

Proposed approval language (for Sam to use in exec note):
"Request approval to proceed with procurement for OptiBatch (one-time $210k) and staged engagement with RedSeal Advisory (one-time $95k) to support Private deployment audits. These items are classified as A-priority because they either reduce ongoing unit costs or directly unblock >$1M in pipeline. Full ROI and SOW to be provided in the procurement packet."

Action items to close in 1:1 (owner / due):
- Priya: firm OptiBatch integration timeline and SOW draft (due: 2026-03-17)
- Mia: negotiate RedSeal payment milestones, push partial invoicing tie to milestones (due: 2026-03-14)
- Marco: pilot pricing proposal from TraceLens and retention tier analysis (due: 2026-03-20)
- Me (Ava): prepare exec note + packet for approvals page (attach SOWs, ROI table) (due: 2026-03-12)
- Sam: confirm approval gate (finance vs. exec) threshold and suggest next meeting slot (due: 2026-03-12)

Notes to self (scratchy):
- Bring the "cost-per-token" vs "license" delta chart — helps justify OptiBatch.
- Double-check whether TraceLens includes token-level ingestion costs in their quote. If so, push for cap.
- If Sam wants to defer TraceLens, propose a 60-day pilot with success metrics (cost attribution coverage >= 70% on top routes).

Follow-up template (email after 1:1):
Hi Sam,
Thanks for the quick sync — capture below the decisions and next steps. I will circulate the procurement packet for OptiBatch + RedSeal by EOD Thursday. Please confirm whether we should escalate TraceLens pricing to exec review if pilot terms are not acceptable.

[attach: simple ROI table, SOW drafts, vendor quotes]

-- Ava

Misc scratch ideas (non-blocking):
- Explore vendor financing or net-60 for large one-time invoices to smooth Q1 cashflow.
- Consider a small internal trial (2-week) with OptiBatch to validate infra assumptions before full SOW.

End of notes.
